ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 17
   D. 8

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 20

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

4. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 29

5. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 17
   D. 3

7. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 24.5

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 32
   C. 22
   D. 16

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

13. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

18. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

20. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 17

21. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 2

22. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 22

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

24. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
